title: KG-GPT and Linear Graph Representation via Edge Tables
summary: This community focuses on the technical implementation of KG-GPT, a method that integrates knowledge graph data with Large Language Models (LLMs). It highlights the use of Adjacency and Edge Table formats as primary techniques for linearizing non-Euclidean graph structures. By converting retrieved subgraphs into linear triple sequences, KG-GPT overcomes the challenge of feeding structured graph data directly into LLMs.
key_findings: KG-GPT decomposes complex queries into sub-queries and retrieves relevant information for each in a single process.
The method applies the Adjacency / Edge Table technique by linearizing the triples found in the retrieved subgraph.
These linearized triples are concatenated and fed directly into LLMs to enable effective processing of structured graph information.
The Edge Table format is characterized as a straightforward, linear representation that details all edges within a graph.
The Adjacency Table is noted for enumerating immediate neighbors, offering a compact representation suitable for sparse graphs.
Both table-based formats are described as brief, easy to understand, and intuitive methods for describing graph structures.
